Grep failed because it was run on a directory without recursive flags. Both useMemos and useInfiniteMemos call listMemos.

useInfiniteMemos is the primary frontend hook for the main list UI. The six-hop trace maps each role to its file path.

The frontend hook is `useInfiniteMemos` in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`. The client is `memoServiceClient` in `web/src/connect.ts`.

The proto RPC is `ListMemos` in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. The backend handler is `APIV1Service.ListMemos` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. The store method is `Store.ListMemos` in `store/memo.go`. The sqlite dialect implementation is `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`.
